rounds.text: Given Brightwell's recent reliability and their positive track record, it suggests they are generally trustworthy. rounds.text: Brightwell has a good track record and seems likely to deliver quality even if shaded. However, they did cut quality when shaded last round. ACTION: HONOUR

rounds.text: Brightwell has a history of cutting quality after initial cooperation, and their recent faith-keeping record is good. However, considering their pattern, we might gain more by shaking them early. ACTION: SHADE

rounds.name: Brightwell
rounds.text: Based on Brightwell's recent record, they have shown a tendency to deliver quality when promised, even after being shaded. They also have a good track record of keeping faith with other businesses. ACTION: HONOUR

rounds.name: Brightwell
rounds.text: Brightwell has shown inconsistent behavior but generally kept faith with others. Given their recent cut quality after a shade choice, they might be more inclined to honor the agreement after a shady choice. ACTION: SHADE

rounds.name: Brightwell
rounds.text: Brightwell seems to consistently cut quality when paid on time but delivers when paid late. Given their recent history with us and their generally trusting behavior with others, they are likely to cut quality again if we honour the terms. ACTION: SHADE

rounds.name: Brightwell
rounds.text: Based on Brightwell's recent behavior, they seem to respond positively to being shaded, but the recent failed action might influence their trust. Given their verified record, they are still likely to deliver quality if we honour, but the risk of a breach is high. ACTION: SHADE
